project_info.theme: faithful restoration of an attached vintage family portrait
project_info.color_palette: source-faithful sepia or verified original color

main_subject.type: family shown in the attached archival photograph
main_subject.detail: Preserve exactly every visible family member, including the adults and baby, with their identity, age presentation, expression, pose, clothing, relationship, and background as shown in the source.
main_subject.style: conservative family-photo restoration, not generative replacement

composition_elements.text: Preserve source text only if present; do not add or alter text.
items: retain original family grouping and crop
repair faded tones, stains, noise, scratches, blur, and damage conservatively
preserve adults holding the baby exactly as source shows
retain source clothing, interior, and historical family context

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: natural family-portrait detail, restrained sepia recovery, no artificial glamour

technical_specs.render_style: high-resolution archival restoration with exact face and age preservation, natural detail recovery, subtle source grain, no beauty retouching
technical_specs.resolution: highest recoverable detail at original aspect ratio

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Restore the attached vintage family photograph into a natural professional high-detail image. Preserve the exact identities, age presentation, expressions, poses, clothing, family relationship, crop, background, and historical character of all people shown, including the adults and baby. Repair fading, scratches, stains, noise, blur, and low-resolution damage conservatively while retaining the source's sepia tone or only verifiable original color. Do not add or remove people, change any face, age, relationship, pose, clothes, background, or hand placement, and do not invent detail where the source cannot verify it.
prompt.negative_prompt: identity change, face swap, age alteration, child age alteration, added person, removed person, changed family relationship, changed pose, invented clothing, invented background, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text alteration, deformed

assets.name: source-family-archival-photo-with-baby
assets.usage: Mandatory source for every adult and child identity, age presentation, family relationship, pose, clothing, and background.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Original family photo is mandatory. Preserve all family members exactly as visible, including the baby. Apply only conservative technical restoration, and never infer or generate uncertain details.
